defects.finding: The note says the record belonged to Ford Model T before the appearance of Beetle. The retained source distinguishes appearance/production of the model in 1938 (L238-L241) from the record changing in 1972 (L242). The current phrasing can misleadingly identify the model debut as the event ending the Ford record, instead of the much later sales-record transition. The distinct previous-record claim is admissible, but its temporal relation should be stated precisely.
